text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.

- Employees of state chemicals company Quimigal are offering 8.569 billion escudos for 90 percent of its capital, in competition against another consortium comprising the Mello group and Belgian company Sapec offering 8.141 billion escudos.
- Shipowners decided yesterday to stage protests against a decree ordering fishermen not to fish in the high seas for 24 hours during weekends.

- Saudi Aramco has proposed to buy a stake of state oil company Petrogal at a price based on a valuation by J.P.Morgan. Under-Secretary for Energy Jose Penedos said an agreement could be reached by the end of the month.
